verdict.rationale: Headless or CI operation is a fair question for an SSH client, but the evidence only describes interactive GUI and mobile features such as snippets run from the Snippets screen, broadcast input in workspaces, and startup snippets. Nothing documents a CLI, headless mode, or CI integration, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path. These interactive automation features are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
